name: 陳立憲
objective:
基礎工程係應用土壤力學之原理於基礎問題之分析，其內容包括下列各項：(1) 基礎之定義：功用及其重要性、(2) 土壤調查、(3) 基礎之水、防水及開挖、(4) 基礎之承載力、5) 基礎之應力分析與沈陷計算 (6) 基腳及筏式基礎、(7) 樁基、(8) 墩基、(9) 沈箱基礎、(10) 基礎穩定處理。
Subsurface investigations and synthesis of soil parameters for geotechnical design and analysis, concepts of shallow and deep foundation design, geotechnical design of conventional retaining walls, computerized analysis and design of soil / foundation interaction; case histories.
schedule:
Wk. 1. Introduction
Wk. 2 Review (土壤之剪力強度: 直 (接) 剪 (力)、三軸 (間接) 試驗) ch. 10
Wk. 3-5 邊坡穩定: 有限、無限邊坡 ch. 14 (自然邊坡)
Wk. 6-7 側向土壓: 主動、被動破壞 ch. 12 (人工邊坡)
Wk. 8 Flipped Classroom -- Project Presentation
Wk. 9 Mid-term Exam.
Wk. 10-12 淺 基 礎: 強度、沉陷控制 ch. 11
Wk. 13 Flipped Classroom -- Project Presentation
Wk. 14- 16 深 基 礎: 單樁、群樁分析 ch. 15
Wk. 17 Flipped Classroom -- Project Presentation
其他: 地下調查 (工址調查) ch.10 & 擋土、橫撐分析
Wk. 18 Final Exam.
scorePolicy:
Homework assignment & Quizes (30%)
Mid-term Exam. 35 %
Final Exam. 35 %
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】



Fundamentals of Geotechnical Engineering, by B. M. Das, 5th ed., 2012
consultation: 於 office hours 至系館二樓大地研究室與任課老師討論、諮詢、請教。
延伸教學與資源:
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
